item.title: VIDEO | Uttar Pradesh: The Indian Air Force is marking its 94th anniversary on Thursday with a ceremonial parade and a static display of some of its p...
item.description:
VIDEO | Uttar Pradesh: The Indian Air Force is marking its 94th anniversary on Thursday with a ceremonial parade and a static display of some of its prized combat assets at the Hindan Air Force Station in Ghaziabad.

The parade began in the presence of the three service chiefs, senior military officials, and several former chiefs of the IAF.

IAF Chief Air Chief Marshal AP Singh arrived at the parade venue in a 1960s-era vintage car as three helicopters in 'Dhwaj' formation performed a flypast overhead.

On the tarmac, the Air Force put a formidable lineup of combat power on static display, including frontline fighter jets like the Rafale, Su-30 MKI, and Jaguar; indigenous rotary platforms such as the Light Combat Helicopter (LCH) Prachand and Advanced Light Helicopter (ALH) Dhruv; alongside critical weapon and air defence systems.

The celebrations highlight the evolving operational readiness, self-reliance under Aatmanirbhar Bharat, and decades of service in safeguarding the nation's skies of the force.

(Source: IAF Youtube)

item.title: 🇮🇩 🚨 JUBELIO (INDONESIA) E-COMMERCE SAAS DATA AND SOURCE CODE ALLEGEDLY FOR SALE A threat actor on an underground forum claims to be selling ...
item.description:
🇮🇩 🚨 JUBELIO (INDONESIA) E-COMMERCE SAAS DATA AND SOURCE CODE ALLEGEDLY FOR SALE

A threat actor on an underground forum claims to be selling 17GB of "freshly dumped" data plus 6GB of source code allegedly taken from Jubelio, which the seller describes as one of Indonesia's biggest cloud-based e-commerce sales platforms.

The listing names tables from three databases:
* Payment: invoices, transactions, invoice fees, tenants, users, providers, VAT settings
* Shipment: courier and AWB records, tracking, COD confirmations, customer tokens, marketplace/Shopify and SSO users
* System: billing, payment gateway, marketplace settlements, KYC reports, password history
* Plus 6GB of application source code

The claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
Jubelio is an omnichannel SaaS used by many online sellers, so a genuine dump would expose data across many merchants and their end customers at once (orders, shipping and payment records, marketplace tokens). Stolen source code could also help attackers find new flaws in the platform. The seller shows only table names, no sample records, and has no track record (a single forum post). Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation that Jubelio systems were breached.

#DDW #DarkWeb #Indonesia #Jubelio #Ecommerce #SaaS #SupplyChain #DataLeak #ThreatIntelligence #CyberSecurity

item.title: VIDEO | Goa: Veteran actor Nana Patekar passes away at 75. Dr Shekhar Salkar, a senior doctor at Manipal Hospital, says, "Our favourite actor Nana Pat...
item.description:
VIDEO | Goa: Veteran actor Nana Patekar passes away at 75. Dr Shekhar Salkar, a senior doctor at Manipal Hospital, says, "Our favourite actor Nana Patekar was brought dead to our hospital and was declared dead at 5.20 am today. His caretaker arrived at around 4.18-20 am, took our ambulance and went to his flat, which is nearby. By the time our team reached there, he was already on the ground, unconscious and almost unresponsive. They started CPR and shifted him to the hospital while continuing CPR. He was brought here in about 10 minutes, and we continued CPR here as well. But it was like he was brought dead. So we had to register a medico-legal case, and the body has now been shifted to Goa Medical College for post-mortem. It was a cardiac arrest, but we do not know the cause. He was a known cardiac patient and was on medication, as far as we have been told."

(Full video available on PTI Videos - http://ptivideos.com)

item.description:
🇲🇲 🚨 5BB BROADBAND (MYANMAR) ISP DATABASE ALLEGEDLY FOR SALE

A threat actor on an underground forum is selling a database dump they say comes from 5BB Broadband, a Myanmar internet provider offering fiber (FTTH), 4G/LTE wireless and business internet to homes and companies across the country.

The listing shows:
* Claimed victim: 5BB Broadband (Global Technology Company Limited)
* Asking price: $780, negotiable, in cryptocurrency
* A sample and "proof images" offered to buyers (not shared here)
* The contents of the dump are not itemized in the post

The claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
If genuine, an ISP customer database typically holds names, phone numbers, addresses and service or billing records, which in Myanmar's environment also carries surveillance and targeting risk for subscribers. The low price and missing field list point to a modest or partial dump, and the seller gives no record count. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation that 5BB systems were breached.

The world is aware of Pakistan's financial support to terrorism as also the FATF plenary meeting coming up soon. Yet, we also remember that just a few months ago, Pakistani representatives used this forum to call the Jaish-e-Mohammed a defunct organisation. The world has seen this script play earlier and we are clear-eyed that this time also it is going to be no different. item.title: ⚠️ UNPATCHED CRITICAL LMCACHE FLAW LETS UNAUTHENTICATED ATTACKERS RUN CODE ON LLM CACHE SERVERS (CVE-2026-105192, CVSS 9.8) JFrog Security Research ...
item.description:
⚠️ UNPATCHED CRITICAL LMCACHE FLAW LETS UNAUTHENTICATED ATTACKERS RUN CODE ON LLM CACHE SERVERS (CVE-2026-105192, CVSS 9.8)

JFrog Security Research has disclosed an unauthenticated remote code execution flaw in LMCache, a KV-cache layer for LLM inference used with engines such as vLLM. No fixed release is available yet.

• Where: multiprocess (distributed) mode opens a ZeroMQ socket, port 5555 by default, with no authentication
• How: one message type is decoded with Python pickle before the request handler runs, so a single crafted message runs code as the LMCache process user, which is root in the official container images
• Affected: v0.3.9 through v0.5.5 (the latest PyPI release), plus the v0.5.6 release candidates through rc3 and the dev branch
• Exposure: the socket binds to localhost by default. The 9.8 score applies when an operator binds it to a routable address, the documented multi-node setup. LMCache running only inside a vLLM process does not open this port

⚠️ Analyst Note:
No exploitation in the wild has been reported, and the flaw is not in CISA KEV. Until a patch ships, JFrog advises keeping the multiprocess port on localhost or a trusted cluster network. A firewall narrows who can reach it, but any host that can still connect can run code.

Source:
https://research.jfrog.com/vulnerabilities/lmcache-is-vulnerable-to-unauthenticated-remote-code-execution-via-pickle-deserialization-on-the-multiprocess-zmq-transport-cve-2026-105192-jfsa-2026-001694382/

item.title: 🚨 POELLM BOTNET INFECTS 3,400+ EXPOSED AI AND DEV SERVERS, HIDES ITS C2 ADDRESS IN A POEM ON GITHUB Lumen's Black Lotus Labs says the PoeLLM malwar...
item.description:
🚨 POELLM BOTNET INFECTS 3,400+ EXPOSED AI AND DEV SERVERS, HIDES ITS C2 ADDRESS IN A POEM ON GITHUB

Lumen's Black Lotus Labs says the PoeLLM malware has hit more than 3,400 servers since April 2026, mostly vulnerable internet-facing LiteLLM, Ollama, Gotenberg and Gitea deployments, with possible targeting of Ivanti Sentry. Most victims are in the US and Western Europe.

• The malware works out its C2 IP address from four keywords in a poem kept in a GitHub repository. The actor has edited the poem 11 times since April 13, each time pointing the bots to a new server
• Infected hosts mine cryptocurrency with XMRig and Iron and are reused to scan for and exploit new victims
• Several C2 servers ran on hijacked routers with vulnerable admin pages
• Lumen says a LiteLLM endpoint tied to command-injection flaw CVE-2026-42271 was likely the exploitation path
• Lumen links PoeLLM to an Italian-speaking actor, says the campaign appears financially motivated, and has blocked traffic to and from its C2 servers

⚠️ Analyst Note:
Activity peaked at roughly 800 active bots a day. Self-hosted AI services combine known bugs with powerful hardware, which makes them attractive mining targets. Keep LiteLLM, Ollama, Gotenberg and Gitea patched and off the open internet, and check network logs against the IOCs Lumen published.

Source:
https://www.lumen.com/blog/en-us/canto-incognito-tracking-the-poellm-malware

A threat actor on an underground forum is selling what they claim is a France Travail database that "only contains employee data", 62,848 rows, in a listing titled "France Travail September 2026".

The listing shows:
* Claimed source: France Travail, the French public employment service (formerly Pôle emploi)
* Data scope: agency staff, not jobseekers
* Fields: names, job function and sub-role, landline and mobile numbers, emails, site and department, region, structure type, internal system identifiers, access-authorization profile and photo URL
* Sample rows of staff records (redacted here)

The claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
If genuine, this is a staff directory of a large public agency: names, roles, direct phone lines and internal IDs are exactly what attackers need for convincing phishing and help-desk social engineering against France Travail employees, which can open the door to jobseeker data. France Travail has reported several data incidents since 2024, so recycled or merged data is possible and the "September 2026" label is the seller's own. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a new France Travail breach.

item.title: 🚨 ATTACKERS HIJACKED THREE COUNTRY-CODE DOMAIN REGISTRIES AND OBTAINED HTTPS CERTIFICATES FOR GOOGLE DOMAINS Google says attackers compromised the ...
item.description:
🚨 ATTACKERS HIJACKED THREE COUNTRY-CODE DOMAIN REGISTRIES AND OBTAINED HTTPS CERTIFICATES FOR GOOGLE DOMAINS

Google says attackers compromised the third-party operators of the .gh (Ghana), .sl (Sierra Leone) and .as (American Samoa) top-level domains, changed authoritative DNS records, and got unauthorized HTTPS certificates for several Google domains and for domains of other organizations.

• Google says its own systems were not compromised, and it has no reason to believe the issuing Certificate Authorities did anything wrong
• Chrome blocked the rogue certificates through CRLSets, and the CAs revoked them for other browsers and clients
• Certificate Transparency logs showed more victims, including several large global brands and popular online services, which Chrome also blocked
• Google learned of the hijacks last week and did not say who was behind them or how the registries were breached
• Chrome users do not need to do anything

⚠️ Analyst Note:
Google warns its analysis may not have found every affected domain, and Chrome's blocking does not protect users of other browsers. Google says any domain ending in .gh, .sl or .as was put at risk. Domain owners should monitor Certificate Transparency logs for their names and lock down which CAs may issue for them.

Official:

item.title: 🇧🇷 🚨 CRUZEIRO DO SUL EDUCACIONAL AND 12 BRAZILIAN UNIVERSITIES ALLEGEDLY BREACHED, 630M+ RECORDS CLAIMED A threat actor on an underground for...
item.description:
🇧🇷 🚨 CRUZEIRO DO SUL EDUCACIONAL AND 12 BRAZILIAN UNIVERSITIES ALLEGEDLY BREACHED, 630M+ RECORDS CLAIMED

A threat actor on an underground forum claims to have fully compromised Cruzeiro do Sul Educacional, one of Brazil's largest private education groups, plus 12 subsidiaries including Unicid, Universidade Positivo, Unipe, Braz Cubas, Unifran, UDF, CEUNSP, Cesuca, FSG, Módulo, FASS and FAPIP.

The listing claims:
* 630M+ rows dumped across the group's environment
* 450,000+ identity-provider records (profiles, logins, account status)
* 107,000+ signed contracts and PDFs with CPF numbers and PII
* 25,884 identity records with tax IDs, emails, roles and passwords
* 3,127 Microsoft 365 staff accounts and 340 privileged accounts
* 27 internal databases plus payroll, salary, HR benefit and dependent data
* A file tree listing 38,198 credentials for employees and students

The claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
If genuine, this would expose students and staff across 13 institutions at once. Plaintext and hashed passwords plus M365 and privileged accounts raise the risk of account takeover and follow-on phishing, while CPF, payroll and bank data are prime material for identity fraud. "630 million rows" counts database rows, not unique people. The actor account is brand new. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation that Cruzeiro do Sul systems were breached; under Brazil's LGPD a confirmed incident would trigger ANPD and data-subject notification.

#DDW #DarkWeb #Brazil #CruzeiroDoSul #Education #DataBreach #LGPD #ThreatIntelligence #CyberSecurity

item.title: RT Sanjay Seth: 📍 भुवनेश्वर आज 24वीं राष्ट्रीय समुद्री खोज एवं बचाव (NMSAR) बोर्ड बैठक में वि...
item.description:
RT Sanjay Seth
📍 भुवनेश्वर

आज 24वीं राष्ट्रीय समुद्री खोज एवं बचाव (NMSAR) बोर्ड बैठक में विभिन्न महत्वपूर्ण विषयों पर चर्चा हुई। भारतीय नौसेना, वायुसेना, ISRO, IMD, INCOIS, तटीय पुलिस, सीमा शुल्क, बंदरगाह प्राधिकरणों सहित विभिन्न हितधारकों की सहभागिता ने भारत के मजबूत अंतर-एजेंसी समन्वय को प्रदर्शित किया।
समुद्र में साहस, तत्परता और मानवीय सेवा के लिए National Maritime Search & Rescue Awards-2026 भी प्रदान किए गए। विभिन्न श्रेणियों में MV Jabal Ali 9, MV Aisopos, IFB Joy Maa Kaliganga, Coast Guard Ship Sachet और Coastal Police Station, Beypore को सम्मानित किया गया।
हाल ही में भारतीय तटरक्षक बल और गुजरात ATS द्वारा अरब सागर में ₹3,000 करोड़ से अधिक मूल्य के मादक पदार्थों की खेप की जब्ती भारत की मजबूत समुद्री निगरानी, खुफिया साझेदारी और अंतर-एजेंसी समन्वय क्षमता का प्रमाण है।
SAREX-2026 के माध्यम से भारत एक मजबूत, तकनीक-सक्षम और वैश्विक रूप से एकीकृत समुद्री खोज एवं बचाव तंत्र की दिशा में आगे बढ़ रहा है।
SAGAR और MAHASAGAR के विजन के अनुरूप समुद्र में प्रत्येक जीवन की सुरक्षा हमारा सर्वोच्च संकल्प है।
@narendramodi @rajnathsingh
@SpokespersonMoD @IndiaCoastGuard

#SAREX2026 #NMSAR #MaritimeSecurity
